selection: one new source/future pair from each of nine pair-eligible SWE-bench Verified repositories, plus one fully disjoint second pair from a repository chosen by a fixed duplicate-repo hash salt
prior_exclusion_rule: exclude all historical C1/ReasoningBank IDs plus all fresh1, fresh2, and fresh3 source/future IDs
repository_pair_weighting: eight repositories contribute one pair and one hash-selected repository contributes two pairs; all primary endpoints remain equal-pair weighted
duplicate_repository_selection: fixed hash salt over repositories that retain at least two unused tasks after their primary pair is chosen
source_gate: all 10 provenance-valid; any consumed-invalid retires the entire fresh4 pool
forbidden: replace or top up a failed source
use the old headless ordinary-text/JSON bridge for fresh4 scientific outputs
execute a future task before source support is 10/10
